Intact rear train stays on rails at upper right, its connection relationship to the hanging front train remains plausible. Keep essential train, fracture, hands and hero fully inside frame. This is vertical camera staging, not a tall crop of the wide composition: use vertical depth, foreshortening and urban height to retain the same geography and information. Modern painterly semi-realistic graphic novel, clear anatomy and silhouettes, golden rimlight, navy/turquoise/copper. Small quiet sky pocket upper-left for later SFX. No words, no speech bubbles, no letters, no sound effect, no watermark, no borders, no extra event.
